::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/customer_segments"}
#docs
Starters are defined in code and present on every business, so the list is never empty; they are read-only and carry `is_starter: true`. Not paginated — a business accumulates a handful.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type; always `customer_segment`. One of `customer_segment`. |
| `data.id` | `string` | seg_…, or seg_starter_… for a starter |
| `data.name` | `string` | The segment's name. |
| `data.description` | `string` | The segment's description. |
| `data.filters` | `array of object` | The predicate, in the customer list's own filter grammar. |
| `data.is_starter` | `boolean` | A definition that ships with the product. Present on every business, read-only, and not stored as a row. |
| `data.starter_key` | `string` | Which starter this was copied from, if any. |
| `data.created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the customer segment was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `data.updated_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the customer segment was last changed (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `data.answerable` | `boolean` | On the list only: whether this business can resolve the segment. False for an `mrr` threshold with no currency pinned on a book billing in several currencies. |
| `data.refusal` | `string` | On the list only: why it cannot be resolved here, or null when it can. |
| `has_more` | `boolean` | Whether more rows exist after this page. |
| `next_cursor` | `string` | Opaque; pass as starting_after |
| `next_offset` | `string` | Present only while has_more; the same opaque token as next_cursor — pass as offset |
| `total` | `integer` | Filtered-set count; first page only |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
